data.content_ref: inline:The isolated block abstracts from both SRC_004 and SRC_006 by representing a measurable 'saddle event': a concrete instance where the lineage-dependency tax and the basin-saddle barrier coincide, making it an empirical test case for whether ownership-based allocation suppresses (SRC_004) or efficiently prunes (SRC_005). This abstraction is refuted if the block lacks sufficient formal structure to test the rival predictions of the suppression and pruning hypotheses.
